business_rules: one cell equals one one-hour attendance
entries normally progress bottom-to-top within a column
after a column fills, entries continue from the bottom of the next column
dates normally progress from past to future
month boundaries and entry-order exceptions are allowed
uncertainty_rules: image evidence takes priority over sequence
do not invent attendance or dates
ambiguous, invalid, or sequence-conflicting readings require review
confidence is not an acceptance criterion
lines, shadows, folds, and stains alone are blank
